title: Provenance
description: Where a record came from and what was done to it. Mapomo's central claim is that its numbers are defensible, and a number is defensible only if its origin and its handling are both recoverable. Every observation, estimate and reference value carries provenance. A record without it is not incomplete, it is inadmissible.

source.description: The origin of the raw material.

type.description: Kind of origin. 'derived' means it came from other Mapomo records, which must then be listed in derivedFrom.

publisher.description: Who issued or held the source. An organization, not an individual. Never a field observer's name.

title.description: Title or description of the source document or feed.

issuedAt.description: Date the source itself was issued or published.

locator.description: URL, archive identifier or internal reference. Prefer an archived copy: an election-period URL is expected to rot or change.

archiveHash.description: Hash of the archived copy, so that later disputes are about interpretation and not about what the document said.

license.description: License or terms under which the source may be used and republished.

accessMethod.description: How access was obtained. Never record credentials or collection identifiers here.

collection.description: How the raw material was turned into a record.

method.description: 'assisted' means a machine proposed and a human accepted or corrected.

toolId.description: Identifier of the Mapomo component that produced the record.

modelId.description: Model identifier where a model was involved, matching a card in mapomo/models.

operatorOrg.description: Organization that carried out the collection. Organizations, never individuals: naming a field observer in a public dataset can put them at risk.

verification.description: Human verification. Machines count; humans verify. Records state which happened.

status.description: 'human_verified' requires an independent check against the source, not merely a glance at the machine output.

note.description: What was checked, and anything the verifier could not confirm.

derivedFrom.description: Identifiers of Mapomo records this one was computed from. Required when source.type is 'derived'. This is what makes an estimate traceable to the observations underneath it.

methodologyRef.description: The versioned protocol under which this record was produced. Pinning the version is what allows a figure to be reproduced after the protocol changes.

notes.description: Anything a later reader needs to judge the record, especially known weaknesses.
